task: COMPLETE: Portable Session History Stack for Omega Engine — 8 tools vetted, 3 installed, comparison matrix delivered. Key findings: (1) OpenCode plugin runtime = Bun 1.2; node:sqlite absent; bun:sqlite rejects URI mode=ro — forecloses all node:sqlite plugins. (2) Native `opencode db` CLI exists but is NOT read-only (I proved this by mutating the live 1.9GB DB). (3) Best portable stack: ochist (primary, cross-agent), sqlite-utils (FTS5 layer), ocdb-ro (safe SQL escape hatch). (4) claude-history (Rust, 498★) installed for Claude Code users. (5) All plugins (opencode-sessions-explorer, opencode-session-search, opencode-session-manager) require Bun plugin runtime — NOT portable.
